Ministry of Finance vide letter eF.No.A-11011/05/2025-Ins.I dated 24th October 2025 had conveyed that the Competent Authority has approved the entrustment of the financial and administrative powers and functions of the Chairman-cum-Managing Director (CMD), General Insurance Corporation of India (GIC-Re) to Shri Hitesh Ramesh Chandra Joshi (DIN:09322218), Executive Director (ED), GIC-Re with effect from 1st October 2025, for a period of three (03) months or until a regular CMD is appointed, or until further order, whichever is earliest. A-11011/05/2025-lns.I dated 07.01.2026, informing that the Competent Authority has approved extension of tenure of powers w.e.f. 01.01.2026 to Shri Hitesh Ramesh Chandra Joshi, ED, GIC Re, for a further period of three (03) months or until a regular CMD is appointed, or until further order, whichever is earliest. The same was informed to the Stock Exchanges on 7th January 2026.
